items.t: Comcast Business Helps Power Content Delivery for 1,200 Movie Theaters Nationwide
items.sum: PHILADELPHIA, November 19, 2026--Comcast Business today announced it has deployed broadband connectivity across 1,200 movie theaters nationwide for the Digital Cinema Distribution Coalition (DCDC), adding high-capacity broadband to support the distribution of feature films, trailers, concerts, sports and other live programming.

items.t: A $400,000 Portfolio in Comcast, Hormel and AT&T Pays $20,500 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA $400,000 portfolio split evenly across Comcast, Hormel Foods and AT&T pays about $20,500 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $1,710 a month. Comcast’s dividend is the best covered of the three, taking 24% of its free cash flow over the last twelve months, against 44% for AT&T and 82% for Hormel.
